column1: ## Repository Table R8. Family-level benchmark summaries

## Description: Thirteen established radar axes. A family may use different checkpoints on different axes. GPN-Star belongs to the GPN family. Clinical reclassification and ClinVar coding/noncoding subsets are not extra axes. Radius=(N-rank+1)/N.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | Domain | Domain for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 2 | Radar axis | Radar axis for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Family | Family for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 4 | Best eligible model | Best eligible model for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 5 | Primary summary | Primary summary for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 6 | Within-axis rank | Within-axis rank for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 7 | Eligible models | Eligible models for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 8 | Radar radius | Radar radius for the observation defined in the table description.
